frame: Who: a seller whose buyer collects in person, mostly Facebook and furniture. Carol meets a stranger rarely and worries about where; a flipper does it weekly.
Came to: say when they are free and where, see who is coming before saying yes, and tell the buyer if plans change.
A mistake costs most where a home address goes out without the person meaning it, a time gets confirmed they never approved, or they meet a stranger after dark somewhere quiet.

Ways out (spec/ways-out.md §6.9, spec/edge-cases.md §16): Suggest another or Decline the buyer's pick; running late, another time, share my plan, cancel with Undo; share an address only on its own tap, with the public spot first.

In the loop: nothing is set up ahead and no calendar is read. The person taps the days and drags the times; the agent's message waits for Send; the buyer's pick waits for Approve; an address waits for its own tap (share_address locked).

decisions.decision: No pickup windows: the next seven days as chips, and a span to drag under each day picked
decisions.why: Ben decided it, 05:18 to 05:24 (product/decisions.md, "no fixed pickup windows"): "some intuitive touch way to interact".

decisions.decision: No day is picked for the person
decisions.why: The agent never guesses when someone is free; the decision says the person taps the days.

decisions.decision: A day's first span is 2 to 4 pm and it snaps to half hours
decisions.why: Daylight by default (edge-cases §16, When); half hours is how people say times.

decisions.decision: A span that ends after dark holds Send until "After dark is fine"
decisions.why: edge-cases §16: a time after dark asks first.

decisions.decision: The place is the saved spot or a safe spot: a police station's safe exchange zone, then a busy lit store
decisions.why: edge-cases §16, Where. A list, not a map, because the kit has no map part yet.

decisions.decision: The agent writes one sentence of times, one of place and a question, as a draft with Send, Edit, Take over
decisions.why: edge-cases §16 step 2: "Never a list of slots, never a form"; replies start as drafts (ways-out §6.3).

decisions.decision: The buyer's pick shows who is coming: name, rating, reviews, time on the site, their messages; Approve is the foot
decisions.why: edge-cases §16 step 3. The worlds hold no buyer photos, so none is drawn.

decisions.decision: Once planned: Add to Google Calendar and Add to Apple Calendar
decisions.why: edge-cases §16 step 4: writing an event needs no reading of the calendar.

decisions.decision: When the buyer asks for the home, keeping the saved spot is the black pill and the address opens its own sheet
decisions.why: ways-out §6.9 and share_address locked: the safer public spot first.

decisions.decision: The two cases no world holds are reached with ?case=ask and ?case=pick
